t: Dinim hashshayyakim ben y"ch leyihyu leratzon
s: Dinim hashshayyakim ben y"ch leyihyu leratzon ubo g' seipim: taqqanat chakamim lomar achar y"ch pasuq "yihyu leratzon vego'" kemo sheamaro david achar y"ch mizmorim, vekevan shehu tiqqun chakamim umikkelal hattepilla — asur lehapsiq beno ley"ch, apillu laanot qaddish uqedushsha, veen tzarik lomar baamirat "elohay netzor" ushear tachanunim sheachar hattepilla sheenan ella minhag velo choba kelal, ella tzarik lomar "yihyu leratzon" qodem "elohay netzor". Veim ba lachazor uleomro paam acheret achar hattachanunim — hareshut beyado. Uben "yihyu leratzon" le"elohay netzor" — muttar lehapsiq (velaanot kol dabar shebbiqdushsha, abal lo dabar acher ad sheyyaaqor raglayv, shehare apillu lazuz mimmeqomo asur ad sheyyipsa g' pesiot laachorayv kemo shennitbaer besiman q"d, vehepseq bedibbur chamur mehalika mimmeqomo, shehare letzorek muttar lehallek veasur ledabber kemo shennitbaer sham. Vaapillu laroq asur qodem sheppasa, lepi sheadayin omed lipne hammelek kemo shennitbaer besiman tz"z, kol shekken ledabber lepanayv debarim acherim). Veim hitchil lomar "elohay netzor" o shear tachanunim vehitchil sheliach tzibbur lesadder tepillato vehiggia liqdushsha — meqatztzer veoleh uposea leacharayv. Vaapillu lo qitztzer — yakol lehapsiq velaanot kederek shemmapsiq laanot bebirkot qeriat shema apillu baemtza, shehattachanunim enam chamurim kitpilla, ap al pi sheadayin lo aqar raglayv. Veyesh omerim sheim eno omer "yihyu leratzon" ad achar siyyum hattachanunim — en bazeh issur, shehare bebirkot y"ch atzman im ba lomar besop kol beraka meen habberaka omer, veen lehachamir ben y"ch leyihyu leratzon yoter mehabberakot atzman. Veken nohagin bimdinot ellu. Vekevan shemmapsiqin ben y"ch le"yihyu leratzon" be"elohay netzor" ushear tachanunim — mapsiq gam ken laanot kol dabar shebbiqdushsha. Umikkol maqom, im yakol leqatztzer betachanunim kede lomar gam "yihyu leratzon" qodem sheyyapsiq — yoter tob leqatztzer. Abal tob lachosh lassebara harishona shehu iqqar, velinhog lekattechilla lomar b' peamim "yihyu leratzon", echad miyyad achar y"ch veechad achar hattachanunim kannahug:
Haragil lomar d' debarim ellu — zokeh umeqabbel pene hashshekina, "aseh lemaan shemeka". "Aseh lemaan yemineka". "Aseh lemaan torateka". "Aseh lemaan qedushshateka":
Yesh nohagin lomar "elohay ad shello notzarti ku'" bekol yom, umuttarim leomero beshabbat:
